\chapter{Misreadings of chaos}
\label{app:misreadings}

\noindent
Every misreading the book sets out to correct, in the order the chapters elicit them. Each is written in the voice of somebody who believes it, followed by what is true instead and the section where the book lets you walk into it first. If you arrived here before reading that section, the entry will make more sense after it: the point of each trap was to be caught by it.

\trapchapter{Chapter~\ref{ch:models}}{A model is a machine for predicting}
\trapentry{11}{A model is a copy of reality.}%
  {A model is a machine for answering questions: numbers in, numbers out, and the only fair test is whether its answers agree with what you then measure.}%
  {\ref{sec:ch01-parts}}
\trapentry{12}{A model that is wrong is useless.}%
  {Every model is wrong, because it leaves something out. The useful question is whether it is good enough, for this question, over this range.}%
  {\ref{sec:ch01-wrong}}
